card.name: Linking words before meal or dose timing
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, before, or) just ahead of a timing phrase about meals or doses, such as 'soon after a meal', 'at least 2 hours before or', 'content or timing of meals'.

modes.label: Before/after spacing
modes.description: The word 'before' in 'at least N hours before or N hours after' dosing instructions.

modes.description: The word 'or' linking macronutrient content to timing of meals or food intake.

modes.label: After a meal
modes.description: The article 'a' between 'soon after' and 'meal' in food-effect statements.
modes.example: Time to effect may be delayed if taken with or soon after<< a>> meal ( 2.1 ).
